ModMetaData.name: Grenade Stack Counter Fix
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Fixes RimWorld 1.5 bill target-count inventory counting for stackable weapons. Vanilla counts map Thing instances for non-resource products, which undercounts grenades and other weapons when a mod gives them stackLimit greater than 1. This patch sums stackCount for weapon products with stackLimit greater than 1 while preserving Vanilla filtering and leaving ordinary items and non-stackable weapons unchanged.
